implementation.receipt_and_provenance_architecture: Fail-closed schema, version, terminal status, owner, correlation, and provenance consistency validation in receipt.py, dispatcher.py, and routes/common.py. Unreceipted runs never return 'real'. Non-terminal runs, absent receipts, missing receipt_id, absent/invalid completed_at (never synthesized), spec_version != '1.0', wrong owner, wrong correlation, or provenance contradicting receipt mode return 'unavailable'. AuthenticStageAdapter and AuthenticResearchBackendClient in real mode strictly validate backend terminal outputs, rejecting missing, non-terminal, or failed outputs, and never rewrite observed simulation/fixture provenance into real mode. Provenance consistency between observed backend output, receipt mode, and metrics is strictly enforced across both dict and ResearchStageResult paths before persistence.
implementation.execution_owner_and_receipt_recording: Authentic execution owner (AuthenticStageAdapter in dispatcher.py) accepts an execution_owner or execute_fn and fails closed when absent in "real" mode. It invokes the real backend via POST /stages/{stage_type}/execute or /api/research-orchestrator/stages/{stage_type}/execute in services/research/main.py, reads back execution receipt/metrics, and enforces that metric/evidence provenance matches execution mode. Research orchestrator HTTP service (/stages/{stage_type}/execute) strictly rejects non-allowlisted stage types (400), enforces presence of governed datasets/inputs without synthetic fabrication (400 on missing input), dispatches only to configured execution owners failing closed (503) for unimplemented or unavailable backends, and strictly preserves simulation provenance (provenance="simulation", receipt.mode="simulation") whenever running stub engines rather than relabeling them as real.
implementation.correlation_chain: Single continuous correlation chain (trace_id / correlation_id) wired across Workshop messages/events, ResearchExecutionReceipt, candidate pool members admitted via CandidatePoolCreateRequest, Trading Room decisions (TraderDecisionRequest), Outbox handoffs (GovernedIntentHandoffRequest), and telemetry-triggered AdjustmentSuggestions via canonical ThresholdTelemetryIncidentConsumer.
implementation.performance_suggestion_consumer: Attached EvaluationTelemetryConsumer to canonical ThresholdTelemetryIncidentConsumer without adding any new background scheduler. Wired CanonicalPerformanceEventTransport with acknowledged delivery: unacknowledged events when no subscribers are active fail closed (RuntimeError) and surface HTTP 503 retryable; outage failures propagate without marking published and successfully recover on replay; retry-safe durable identity prevents duplicate events. In incidents service, suggestions are durably stored in isolated incident-data volume (/data/incidents/agora_performance.sqlite3) and queried by BFF over HTTP (PANTHEON_INCIDENTS_API_URL), eliminating shared/injected SQLite across containers.

mandatory_deletions.client_supplied_real_provenance_flags: Deleted routing.get('backend_mode', 'real') default in _build_run_projection; initial projection defaults to unavailable until authentic ResearchExecutionReceipt is recorded and validated.
mandatory_deletions.fake_synchronous_terminal_fallbacks: Removed fake synchronous completion assumptions; dispatch leaves runs in queued state for outbox worker consumption; removed generic synchronous fallback and hard-coded 0.88/0.92 metric generation for arbitrary stage types in research orchestrator; verified fail-closed lease, retry, DLQ, and crash recovery mechanics without fake synchronous fallback.
mandatory_deletions.manual_only_suggestion_production: Replaced manual suggestion injection with EvaluationTelemetryConsumer attached to canonical ThresholdTelemetryIncidentConsumer.

implementation.rollback_plan: Disable new consumers and deploy the prior exact paper-safe release without deleting canonical receipts.
